content: A quiet mouth is a sweet mouth; the tongue does not wound when the mind is at peace.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Bíonn béal ina thost milis — Irish Gaelic Oral Proverb
explanation: In traditional hearth culture, speech was treated with deep reverence. Cruel remarks, boastful arguments, and reckless gossip sour the sweet atmosphere of the home. The sweetest voice in any dwelling is often the peaceful silence of unhurried presence.
practicalInsight: Before blurting out an emotional complaint today, savor the sweetness of holding silence.
reflectionPrompt: Where would your domestic or professional life immediately improve if you practiced the sweetness of a quiet mouth?
